title: Minimum Impossible OR
description:
You are given an array nums.

You can pick any subsequence (any set of elements, in order) and take their bitwise OR.

An integer x is called expressible if:

You can get x by OR-ing some elements of nums

Your task:

Find the smallest positive integer (> 0) that cannot be formed this way

Example 1
Input: [2,1]
Output: 4
Explanation:

Possible values: 1, 2, (1|2)=3
Missing smallest = 4

Example 2
Input: [5,3,2]
Output: 1
Explanation:

You cannot form 1

Constraints:

1 <= nums.length <= 100000
1 <= nums[i] <= 1e9
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
